purpose: Filter for interested customers before full pitch to increase conversion from 26% to 35%
hypothesis: By asking if customer is interested BEFORE the pitch, we reduce wasted pitches and increase conversion among those who engage
implementation_approach: Add intermediate node between sentiment check and Hawaii offer

instruction.text: I'm so glad I could help! Before you go, quick question - have you ever been interested in visiting Hawaii?

transition_condition.prompt: Customer expresses interest, says yes, or shows curiosity about Hawaii
Customer says no, not interested, or already been many times
Customer is uncertain, says maybe, or asks why you're asking

instruction.text: Wonderful! Then you're going to love this. We're offering an exclusive 5-night Hawaii vacation package in Waikiki for just $699. It's normally over $1,500, but we're extending this limited-time offer to our customers for just the next few days. Would you like to hear more details about what's included?

transition_condition.prompt: Customer wants more details or says yes

instruction.text: I'm asking because we have an incredible limited-time offer right now - 5 nights in Hawaii for just $699, which is over 50% off the regular price. It's only available for a few more days. Would you like to hear the details, or should we wrap up?

transition_condition.prompt: Customer wants to wrap up or declines

flow_modification_instructions.step_3: Add three new nodes: node-hawaii-prequalify, node-hawaii-offer-qualified, node-hawaii-soft-offer
flow_modification_instructions.step_4: Update edges to route through pre-qualification filter

conversion_rate_impact.expected: 35-40% of qualified offered (but fewer total offers)
conversion_rate_impact.mechanism: Pre-qualification filters out 'no' responses before pitch, increasing yes rate among those pitched

offer_frequency_impact.net_result: Slightly fewer offers, but much higher conversion per offer

customer_experience.improvement: Customers who aren't interested get a quick out without full pitch
customer_experience.benefit: Reduces feeling of being 'sold to' for uninterested customers

revenue_impact.net_increase: +3-5 conversions per day = +$2,097 to $3,495 per day
